automation-owned-checks.description: Owned checks: hooks and CI define what must pass; run checks by hand to verify

code-comments.description: Required comments: comment only where a tool or rule needs it, or for a reason the code cannot show

current-state-authority.description: Current state: implement from user requirements and the working tree

demand-driven-configuration.description: Demand-driven configuration: add a setting only for an active requirement

dependency-security.description: Dependencies: add a package only when code or a contract uses it

deterministic-testing.description: Test admission: add a case only when it catches a defect current tests miss

diagnostics-and-error-handling.description: Diagnostics: fix runtime failures at the source and keep the root cause

git-workflow.description: Git workflow: trunk-based branches, commits, and pull requests

no-suppression.description: Findings: fix scanner and linter reports without inline suppressions

script-driven-changes.description: Scripts: apply a repeated edit across many files with a script

single-author-style.description: Sibling style: match layout, naming, and composition in the same project

typescript-first.description: TypeScript-first: write source, tests, and scripts as .ts
